title: Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A comforting, flavorful stew inspired by Kenyan cuisine, with tender lamb and a rich tomato-based sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb shoulder on all sides, then set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes, tomato paste, and Italian seasoning to the pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
